Files vendored (verbatim, unmodified):
- sqlite-vec.c  (the extension; built by llmfun/sqlite3.mak into build/sqlite-vec.o
                 with -DSQLITE_CORE -DSQLITE_VEC_STATIC -Ivendor/sqlite3)
- sqlite-vec.h  (generated header; SQLITE_VEC_SOURCE in it is
                 a66f28f97a9863c17e69e2611af80ddc7fedc2c4, a full commit sha
                 of the same commit's source state)
- README.md     (upstream readme, kept here for provenance and usage docs)

Not vendored (upstream-only, not needed for llmfun's single-file static build):
Makefile, bindings/, tests/, site/, examples/, benchmarks/, scripts/, .github/,
and the packaging files (setup.py, package.json, sqlite-dist.toml, gemspec, ...).

History note:
This directory previously held a different sqlite-vec lineage, v0.1.10-alpha.4
(source id 04d28bd, dated 2026-05-22), which carried four extra experimental
modules (sqlite-vec-diskann.c, sqlite-vec-ivf.c, sqlite-vec-ivf-kmeans.c,
sqlite-vec-rescore.c) #include'd into sqlite-vec.c. Those files did not exist in
the vlasky fork's history and were removed in the update to v0.2.9-alpha.
The fork itself is based on asg017/sqlite-vec v0.1.7-alpha.2; see its
CHANGELOG.md in the upstream repository for everything since.

Update performed: 2026-11-12.
